paths.name: Path of The Rifleman
paths.description: A mastery path focused on long range attacks with your gun

ability.name: Hollow-Points
ability.description: Snipe and Gun Blast will now deal an additional 560 damage over 5 seconds.

ability.name: Crack Shot
ability.description: A well-aimed shot which deals 314 damage and disarms your target for 4 seconds, making them unable to use their weapons.

ability.name: Quick Reloader
ability.description: The cast times of all your abilities in the Path of the Rifleman are reduced by 25%.

ability.name: Snipe
ability.description: A slow but powerful gun shot which deals 762 damage to your enemy and cannot be defended against.

ability.name: Thunderer
ability.description: Grants 10% armor penetration to all rifle attacks and allows auto attacks to fire on the move.

ability.name: Armor-piercing Rounds
ability.description: You load your rifle with the finest of rounds, your attacks will ignore 25% the victim's armor for the next 12 seconds.

ability.name: Scattershot
ability.description: You release a string of several gun blasts in a row for up to 4 seconds, dealing 600 damage each second to all enemies in front of you, up to 40 feet away.

coreAbilities.name: Gun Blast
coreAbilities.description: A gun attack which deals 536 damage to your enemy.

coreAbilities.name: Penetrating Round
coreAbilities.description: You build an upgrade into your Gun Turret.  The Turret will now be able to blast the target with an armor-destroying round, dealing 214 damage and reducing their Armor by 990 for 20 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Incendiary Rounds
coreAbilities.description: You fire bullets that burst into flame when they strike the enemy, dealing 1190 Corporeal damage over 15 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Hip Shot
coreAbilities.description: A quick shot from the hip which deals 291 damage.  This attack may be used at close range.

coreAbilities.name: Machine Gun
coreAbilities.description: You build an upgrade into your Gun Turret.  The Turret will now be able to fire a rapid series of shots at the target for up to 3 seconds, repeatedly dealing 103 damage twice per second.

coreAbilities.name: Signal Flare
coreAbilities.description: You mark the enemy with a bright signal flare, dealing 1708 damage over 21 seconds and reducing their chances to dodge or block attacks by 5%.

coreAbilities.name: Focused Fire
coreAbilities.description: You focus all of your shots on your enemy for up to 3 seconds, dealing 306 damage to them every second. This effect will end if you lose your concentration or run out of action points.

paths.name: Path of The Grenadier
paths.description: A mastery path focused on short-range combat with grenades and bombs

ability.name: Extra Powder
ability.description: Acid Bomb and Fragmentation Grenade gain a 50% increase to the size of their areas of effect.

ability.name: Sticky Bomb
ability.description: A packet of explosives which sticks to your target and slowly burns, dealing 594 Corporeal damage over 15 seconds.  If the effect runs for its full course or the target is killed, then a concealed inner package of explosives will suddenly detonate, dealing 265 Corporeal damage to the victim and all enemies within 20 feet of them.

ability.name: Throwing Arm
ability.description: Increases the ranges of all Path of the Grenadier abilities by 25%.

ability.name: Phosphorous Shells
ability.description: A barrage of mortar attacks which continuously fire at a spot on the ground that you select for up to 6 seconds, dealing 365 Corporeal damage every 2 seconds to all enemies within 20 feet of that spot, and snaring them by 20%. If there are multiple Phosphorous Shells targeting the same, area only the highest level one will deal damage.

ability.name: Dazzling Flash
ability.description: When your Flashbang Grenade detonates, any enemy hit by the blast will become disoriented for 5 seconds, increasing the build times of their abilities by 50%.

ability.name: Napalm Grenade
ability.description:
You toss a grenade packed full of dangerous napalm gel on to the ground, where it will burst open and burn for 30 seconds, causing damage every 2 seconds to any enemies who come within 20 feet of that spot. The fires increase in intensity over time, causing 112 Corporeal damage during the first 10 seconds, 212 Corporeal damage for the next 10 seconds, and 312 Corporeal damage for the final 10 seconds. 
 If there are multiple Napalm Grenades in the same area only the highest level one will deal damage.

ability.name: Artillery Barrage
ability.description: You select a spot on the ground and call in an artillery strike for up to 4 seconds, dealing 600 damage per second to all enemies within 30 feet of that spot.

coreAbilities.name: Firebomb
coreAbilities.description: You toss a grenade filled with flaming pitch which deals 366 Corporeal damage to your target. This ability will continue to build up even if you move.

coreAbilities.name: Acid Bomb
coreAbilities.description: You toss a grenade which splatters a corrosive acid everywhere. Your target and all other enemies within 20 feet of them have Corporeal resistance reduced by 240 and suffer 581 Corporeal damage over 21 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Shock Grenade
coreAbilities.description: You build an upgrade into your Bombardment Turret.  The Turret will now be able to fire a compact shot directly at the target which deals 265 Corporeal damage.

coreAbilities.name: High-Explosive Grenade
coreAbilities.description: You build an upgrade into your Bombardment Turret.  The Turret will now be able to launch a grenade packed with explosives at the target, dealing 216 Corporeal damage to the victim and all enemies within 20 feet of them.

coreAbilities.name: Flashbang Grenade
coreAbilities.description: You toss a grenade which explodes with a burst of force, dealing 403 Corporeal damage to the target.  The blinding flash interrupts the victim and all enemies within 20 feet of them. This ability will continue to build up even if you move.

coreAbilities.name: Fragmentation Grenade
coreAbilities.description: You lob a grenade which shatters when it hits your enemy, dealing 1035 Corporeal damage over 15 seconds to the target and all other enemies within 20 feet of them. This ability will continue to build up even if you move.

coreAbilities.name: Concussion Grenade
coreAbilities.description: You lob a grenade that releases a powerful shockwave on impact, dealing 403 Corporeal damage to your target and knocking them back a short distance.  Monsters will be knocked down instead. This ability will continue to build up even if you move.

paths.name: Path of The Tinkerer
paths.description: A mastery path focused on close combat using your deployables and gadgets

ability.name: Extra Ammo
ability.description: When you construct a turret, it will restore 20 Action Points to everyone within 25 feet every 2 seconds.

ability.name: Lightning Rod
ability.description: You deploy a shock rod at your feet which will remain for up to 9 seconds and periodically blast out with waves of power, dealing 329 Corporeal damage every 3 seconds to all enemies within 25 feet of it.

ability.name: Trench Fighting
ability.description:
Your damage is increased by 15% when under 45 feet away from your target.
Does not affect damage procs.

ability.name: Bugman's Best
ability.description: You carefully unpack a mini-keg of rare and precious Bugman's Finest Stout with reverential awe. For the next 15 seconds, the faint vapors escaping from the keg will rejuvenate any of your groupmates within 25 feet of it, restoring 324 health every 3 seconds. You dream of the day that the brew will be aged enough to actually tap and drink.

ability.name: Tracer Rounds
ability.description: Increases your chance to critically hit by 15% as long as you are within 100 feet of your turret.

ability.name: Electromagnet
ability.description:
You set up a device which unleashes a powerful wave of force, pulling up to six enemy players within 65 feet inwards towards it and knocking down monsters. 1 second later, the device blasts outwards and snares all enemies within 25 feet, reducing their movement speed by 30% for 5 seconds.
The attack uses the Ranged statistic. Monsters will be knocked down by the initial pull.

ability.name: Fling Explosives
ability.description: You fling packets of explosives all around you for up to 4 seconds, dealing 600 damage each second to all enemies within 25 feet.

coreAbilities.name: Friction Burn
coreAbilities.description:
A powerful swipe with your spanner which smacks all enemies in front of you up to 40 feet away, dealing 699 Corporeal damage over 9 seconds.
The attack uses the Ranged statistic.

coreAbilities.name: Blunderbuss Blast
coreAbilities.description: You fire a blast of short-range pellets which deal 203 damage to all enemies in front of you, up to 40 feet away.

coreAbilities.name: Flamethrower
coreAbilities.description: You build an upgrade into your Flame Turret.  The Turret will now be able to release a searing gout of flame, dealing 214 damage to all targets in front of the turret up to 40 feet away.

coreAbilities.name: Steam Vent
coreAbilities.description: You build an upgrade into your Flame Turret.  The Turret will now be able to open its safety-release valves for up to 3 seconds, repeatedly dealing  97 Corporeal damage every 1 seconds to all targets within 25 feet.

coreAbilities.name: Land Mine
coreAbilities.description: You fling out a land mine which arms itself immediately and persists for up to 1 minutes.  The mine will detonate when an enemy gets too close, dealing 343 damage to all enemies within 30 feet and staggering them for up to 3 seconds, preventing all actions unless they are damaged.

coreAbilities.name: Burn Salve
coreAbilities.description: You distribute burn salve to a single group member, increasing their Resistances by 360 for 60 minutes.

coreAbilities.name: Static Discharge
coreAbilities.description: You quickly trigger one of your many gadgets and release a sudden shockwave, dealing 220 Corporeal damage to all enemies within 25 feet.

coreAbilities.name: Strafing Run
coreAbilities.description: You call for air support, signaling for a strafing run which deals 578 damage to all enemies in a line in front of you, up to 65 feet away.  Any enemy players hit by the powerful shells will be sent flying away from you, while monsters will be knocked down.

coreAbilities.name: Bolster War Engine
coreAbilities.note: Not usable on Siege Rams or Oil
coreAbilities.description: Siege Targetted buff. Increases damage done by that siege engine by 2% for 10 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Hamper War Engine
coreAbilities.note: Not usable on Siege Rams or Oil
coreAbilities.description: Siege Targetted debuff. Increases the cooldown times of that siege engine by 50% for 10 seconds

coreAbilities.name: Diminish War Engine
coreAbilities.note: Not usable on Siege Rams or Oil
coreAbilities.description: Siege Targetted debuff. Decreases damage done by that siege engine to 98% for 10 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Flee
coreAbilities.description: You run away from the battle in a mad panic, increasing your run speed by 30% for 10 seconds.  You immediately lose all of your action points, any career mechanic points, and your Morale will begin to drop, and you will not begin to regain action points until 10 seconds have passed.

coreAbilities.name: Spanner Swipe
coreAbilities.description:
You clobber your enemy with your spanner, dealing 253 damage and reducing their run speed by 40% for 10 seconds.
The attack uses the Ranged statistic.

coreAbilities.name: Gun Turret
coreAbilities.description: You construct a turret with a self-aiming gun which will fire at distant enemies. The turret gains 75% of your Ballistic Skill and Weapon Skill from item bonuses and 50% of your Wounds from item bonuses. While you are within 30 feet of the turret you will scavenge extra parts from the turret to create improvised upgrades for your weapons, increasing your damage by 4% every 2 seconds to a maximum of 20%.

coreAbilities.name: Redeploy
coreAbilities.description: You activate your Turret's automatic redeployment mechanism, instantly moving it to your current location.

coreAbilities.name: Flame Turret
coreAbilities.description: You construct a turret with a self-firing flamethrower which will attack enemies at close range.  The turret gains 100% of your Ballistic Skill, 10% of your Weapon Skill, and 90% of your Wounds from item bonuses. While you are within 30 feet of the turret you will scavenge extra parts from the turret to create improvised upgrades for your weapons, increasing your damage by 4% every 2 seconds to a maximum of 20%.

coreAbilities.name: Addling Shot
coreAbilities.description: You Detaunt your target, making them hate you less and causing them to deal 50% damage to you for 15 seconds. You will also deal 50% damage to them until the effect is broken. If you attack anyone that you have Detaunted, the effect will immediately end.

coreAbilities.name: Bombardment Turret
coreAbilities.description: You construct a turret with an auto-firing grenade launcher which will attack enemies at a moderate range.  The turret gains 100% of your Ballistic Skill, 30% of your Weapon Skill, and 70% of your Wounds from item bonuses. While you are within 30 feet of the turret you will scavenge extra parts from the turret to create improvised upgrades for your weapons, increasing your damage by 4% every 2 seconds to a maximum of 20%.

coreAbilities.name: Point-Blank
coreAbilities.description: A mid-range attack that deals 600 damage and knocks the targeted player away. Monsters will be knocked down.

coreAbilities.name: Stoutness of Stone
coreAbilities.description: Increases Toughness by 80. You also recover from Stuns, Staggers and Knockdowns 1 seconds quicker. You will still gain immunity based on the original duration.

coreAbilities.name: Barbed Wire
coreAbilities.description: You fling coils of barbed wire all around you, rooting all enemies within 25 feet in place for 5 seconds. There is a 50% chance of the root breaking with every hit.

coreAbilities.name: Flak Jacket
coreAbilities.description: You don an experimental suit of protective gear, increasing the Armor of group members within 100 ft by 396 for 60 minutes, while increasing your Armor by 792 for 60 minutes.

coreAbilities.name: Expert Skirmisher
coreAbilities.description: Your cast times are reduced to 50% when you are within 20 feet of your target.

coreAbilities.name: Reinforced Casing
coreAbilities.description: Adds 160 Wounds to your turrets.

coreAbilities.name: Masterful Aim
coreAbilities.description: Increases your Ballistic Skill by 160

coreAbilities.name: Concealment
coreAbilities.description: With luck and experience you are able to Dodge all ranged attacks and Disrupt all magic attacks against you for 7 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Stopping Power
coreAbilities.description: Hip Shot now will knock the victim back a short distance.

coreAbilities.name: Stubbornness
coreAbilities.description: Increases your Corporeal resistance by 252.

coreAbilities.name: Focused Mind
coreAbilities.description: For the next 10 seconds, you will remove and ignore any rooting, snaring, disarming, silencing or disabling effects. Your cast times are reduced by 50%, and you cannot be set back.

coreAbilities.name: Hand-Crafted Scope
coreAbilities.description: Increases your autoattack speed by 50% when using a gun.

coreAbilities.name: Shock Grenade
coreAbilities.description: You toss a grenade at an ally which removes stagger effects from them and five others within 25 feet.

coreAbilities.name: Ancestral Inheritance
coreAbilities.description: Increases your Armor by 660.

coreAbilities.name: Explosive Shots
coreAbilities.description:
All of your ranged attacks will explode for the next 10 seconds, dealing 300 damage to all enemies within 20 feet of your target.
This effect will not trigger more than once every second.

coreAbilities.name: Self-Destruct
coreAbilities.description: You activate the self-destruct mechanism built into your turret, destroying the turret and dealing 370 Corporeal damage to all enemies within 25 feet of it, knocking them down for 3 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Clever Recovery
coreAbilities.description:
If an enemy dodges any of your attacks, you will regain 75 Action Points.
This effect will not trigger more than once every 3 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Autoloader
coreAbilities.description: You regain action points 30% faster for 10 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Pierce Defenses
coreAbilities.description: If an enemy blocks, dodges, or parries any of your attacks, their chances to dodge and parry will be reduced by 10% and their ability to block reduced by 5% for 10 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Well-Oiled Machine
coreAbilities.description: You can now construct your turrets instantly and the cost of Redeploy is reduced to 0 Action Points.

coreAbilities.name: Armored Plating
coreAbilities.description: Everyone in your group within 100 feet takes only 80% damage for 20 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Mortar Round
coreAbilities.description: You fire a mortar at your target, dealing 300 damage to them and everyone within 20 feet every second for 4 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Fightin' Chance
coreAbilities.description: Increases your Strength, Ballistic Skill, and Weapon Skill by 120, but reduces your Toughness by 120.

coreAbilities.name: Proximity Alarm
coreAbilities.description: Increases the chance to detect hidden enemies by 50% for yourself and group members within 20 feet of your turret. This effect only applies to players who are in range.

coreAbilities.name: Cannon Smash
coreAbilities.description: A massive cannonball smashes into your target, dealing 1800 damage  and reducing their armor by 1320 for 15 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Tangling Wire
coreAbilities.description: After ending or being removed, Barbed Wire will now Snare targets by 30% and deal 330 damage over 5 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Coordinated Fire
coreAbilities.description:
Signal Flare will now also cause the victim to suffer 15% more damage from all sources.
Does not affect damage procs.

coreAbilities.name: Hail of Doom
coreAbilities.description: You focus on a spot on the ground, shooting arrows at that spot every 0.5 seconds for 5 seconds, hitting all enemies within 20 feet of that area for 300 damage as long as you maintain your concentration.
